sql: WITH SeniorityMedian AS (SELECT seniority, AVG(comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us GROUP BY seniority), OverallMedian AS (SELECT AVG(comp_mid_usd) AS overall_median_pay FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us) SELECT sm.seniority, sm.median_pay, sm.median_pay - om.overall_median_pay AS difference_from_overall FROM SeniorityMedian sm, OverallMedian om
